name: Darius
overview: The biblical figure Darius, identified as a Mede and king of Persia, plays a significant role in the post-exilic restoration period. Scripture highlights his reign over the Persian kingdom, during which he supported the Jewish people, as seen in references to the Levites and priests recorded up to his reign (Nehemiah 12:22) and prophetic messages delivered in his second year (Haggai 1:1, 1:15; Zechariah 1:1). Notably, Darius is recognized for emancipating the Jews, allowing them to rebuild and worship freely under his authority (Daniel 5:31; Daniel 9:1). These passages affirm God's providence in using Darius to fulfill His purposes for His covenant people.
